notes.title: v1.0 Is Live
notes.notes:
Hello!
The latest playtest update is now live. I'm calling this one 1.0. What's new to justify such a bold version number?

- The game has an ending now
- Endless mode now unlocks after finishing the game*
- Linux build bug is fixed; should now run natively
- Some new messages/lore
- Many small balance tweaks
- Many small optimizations (with more on the way)

*This has not been tested too thoroughly yet, and it's hard to predict how the gameplay mechanics might unfold after a few hours of play. Let's find out together!

Many thanks for playing!

notes.title: 0.07: Playtest feedback & bugfix bonaza
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello![/h1] 

Many thanks to all who have checked out the playtest — there have now been over 1500 of you, which is very cool. The game has received a ton of useful feedback on Discord, Reddit, and here on Steam, which has been incredibly helpful. I have broadly split this feedback into 'gameplay' and 'story'. This update specifically targets the 'gameplay' side of things, with a 'story' update coming soon. Here's a list of changes that have made their way in:

 [h2]0.07 Release Notes[/h2] [list] [*]Added billing breakdown window that provides a per-second breakdown of income and outgoings. Makes it much easier to figure out cause & effect.[/*] [*]Improved 'Impact Prediction'. This is now its own window, and provides full estimates how upgrades will impact usage.[/*] [*]Hovering over graphs in the monitor increases their size and provides more stats.[/*] [*]Reworked harvesting system. Data is now harvested into dataset form, after which it can be processed as normal.[/*] [*]Reworked cluster computing upgrade so it's 1/10th as powerful but also 1/10th the price. Reduces grind.[/*] [*]Viruses now delete one random piece of software. Increases peril.[/*] [*]Add options menu with volume control, windowed mode settings, and experimental font size scaling feature, and option to switch temperature measurement from F to C.[/*] [*]Memory used now has much less impact on processing power used, as this made little sense.[/*] [*]Processing power from clicks per second has been boosted to offset the above change.[/*] [*]Ensure antivirus and firewall make viruses and disconnections impossible at max level (instead of just very unlikely).[/*] [*]Fix issue where clicking windows would often drag other random windows to the front, too.[/*] [/list] [h3]Smaller changes & bugfixes:[/h3] [list] [*]Hopefully fix Steam game ID issue.[/*] [*]Reworked CO2 figures to be higher.[/*] [*]Improve email readout queue system.[/*] [*]Electricity generators now use more emissions than they did before.[/*] [*]Fix bug where downgrading often broke temperature.[/*] [*]Fix last cluster computing node from disconnecting multiple times.[/*] [*]Fix camera naming error.[/*] [*]Fix impact prediction for cameras.[/*] [*]Fix misc. audio bugs.[/*] [*]Ensure marketplace greys out items that aren't purchasable.[/*] [*]Stop payments from being deducted during tutorial.[/*] [*]Fix bug where total cameras count was inaccurate.[/*] [*]Fix MP3 player dragging issue.[/*] [/list]

Hello! 
0.05 of the playtest is now live, featuring the following updates & improvements.

- Better UI for loading previous playthroughs
- 'Infinite money glitch' mode (unlocked after completing the game)
- Stability improvements
- Fix bug that was making the videos in the end game sequence not play correctly
- Some other small UI/UX tweaks and bugfixes, too small to mention but large enough to [i]feel[/i].

As always, thank you for playing!

notes.title: 0.04 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Little patch that does a few things.

- FINALLY pinned down the rendering bug where aliasing would look off (overly sharp and hard to read) on larger screens. Expect a smoother, more luxurious eyefeel from here on out.
- Fixed bug that appeared in the previous update where the game would always be in easy mode, regardless of what difficulty was picked. My apologies for this one.
- Misc small style tweaks.

Thank you for playtesting.

notes.title: Playtest v0.04 Released
notes.notes:
Hello!
0.04 of the Playtest has just been pushed. In brief, this update focuses on the narrative elements of the game. More emails, more lore, and an ending that a little more impactful. Hopefully. Let me know what you think in the Discord, if you get a chance.
Thanks for playing! More soon.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Version 0.03
notes.notes:
New update! Has been a second, but this has some relatively chunky stuff in. Some of it is still pretty experimental and/or in progress, so expect some rough edges!

Changes:

— New virus (/antivirus) mechanic
— New Cluster Computing ‘minigame’; nodes can be come disconnected and need reconnecting.
— Big upgrade & rewrite of the FACEMINER Administration emails, for which I am entirely indebted to [b]Invotek[/b]. A very large thank you.
— Reworked 'Impact Prediction' so it uses numbers instead of showing up on the graphs. Hopefully this is a little more usable (though still ironing out the last few glitches here)
— Balance tweaks around cameras & emissions
— Many misc small UI/UX bits
— Many of the reported bugs in the feedback channel on Discord

notes.title: Launching: FACEMINER Full Game Pre-Alpha Version 0.02
notes.notes:
Hello,
The Full Game Pre-Alpha Version 0.02 of FACEMINER is now available to download as a Playtest. Expect spoilers, bugs, and plenty of placeholder text -- but also a completable, end-to-end experience. As always, any feedback and bug reports are very welcome in Discord & on the Steam Forums. Thank you for following the game!

0.095 of the demo playtest has now been released. We are getting closer to 1.0 now!

Updates include:

- Save/load functionality! Save your progress -- at a cost -- via the 'software' tab in the marketplace (TBD if it stays there)
- Bought back AI generated (rather than public domain) faces, now Steam has refined their AI generated content policy. AI generated faces are generated using a GAN trained specifically on the NVIDIA FFHQ dataset.
- Pause functionality! The game pauses when you open the menu (or press escape).
- System impacts are now simulated in advance when 'buy' is hovered, in an effort to decrease unpredictability.
- Related to the above, a warning is given if you are about to do something that massively increases your energy bill (80%+ increase).
- Fixed the placement of windows on larger screens/resolutions.
- The beginnings of a ranking/role system! With thanks to @entechcore for the suggestion. Climb the corporate ranks as you play.
- Downgrade functionality! Sell off your upgrades, albeit for a heavy discount.
- Tweaks to harvesting costs & impact. Finding it a little tricky to balance this in the context of the shortened demo; it may have to live on solely in the full game.
- Many more small tweaks, balances, bugfixes, improvements
